text:
oliver: Heads-up: release CI blocked by regen diff on sample-app onboarding branch. Looks like typegen property order flipped.
ci-bot: buildkite: #4782 failed during `yarn regen` :x: logs attached.
rhea: Minimal failing diff: 
```diff
- export interface OnboardingPayload { username: string; email?: string }
+ export interface OnboardingPayload { email?: string; username: string }
```
mina: That's the old nondeterministic OpenAPI ordering again. Typegen preserves input order unless `--stable` canonicalizes keys.
patrick: changelog-bot bumped minor because a tracked file changed (types). That triggered semver guard and prevented publish. We should exclude generated files from semver decisions.
ichangelog-bot: changelog: Detected file changes -> suggested bump: minor.
ivy: Short fixes: 1) add `src/generated/**` to .semver-ignore 2) run `yarn typegen --stable` and commit regenerated files 3) set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in CI matrix to skip interactive onboarding
oliver: I'll push the CI env var change. Rhea, can you add the semver-ignore and run stable regen?
rhea: On it. Also opening tiny PR to add a PR checklist item: "did you run `yarn typegen --stable`?"
mina: Long-term we should make deterministic output the default and flip `--stable` to on. Also coordinate node/npm versions across runners; prettier/tsc differences can surface tiny diffs.
ci-bot: oliver pushed CI fix, rerunning build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #4782 rerun passed :white_check_mark:
patrick: After merging the semver-ignore + stable regen PR, changelog-bot treats the change as docs-only and no bump happened. Release unblocked.
oliver: Great work. Follow-ups: RFC to default deterministic typegen, add regen check to PR template, and add a quick devex doc about `--stable`. Closing once release merged. :rocket:
